URL: https://www.gov.uk/government/speeches/home-secretary-earned-settlement-statement
Published: 2 November 2026. Delivered by the Rt Hon Shabana Mahmood MP, Home Secretary, House of Commons.
(WebFetch summary extraction — not full verbatim text)

Disqualifying criteria for settlement: criminal record; failure to speak English to high standard; unpaid debt to British taxpayer; failure to make 3 years of National Insurance contributions.

Pathways (as extracted):
- 3-year path: highest earners (£125,000+) and those on talent schemes
- 5-year path: salaries over £50,000; doctors, nurses, teachers; social care workers earning £25,000+ who fulfilled visa conditions; refugees arriving via safe/legal routes
- 10-year path: all those earning less than £50,000; refugees who work or study
- 20-year path: those committing immigration breaches; refugees arriving by illegal methods
- Plus 10 years additional for small boat arrivals (total 30 years)

Social care transitional arrangement: applies to workers who joined before the May 2025 Immigration White Paper publication; allows a second 5-year visa opportunity.

Quote: "Settlement should not be automatic. It should be earned." (Mahmood)
